scripts.dev: npm run build:client && npm run dev:server
scripts.bd-bg: mbt build -p=cf --mtar=btp-admin.mtar && cf deploy mta_archives/btp-admin.mtar -f --retries 1 --strategy blue-green --skip-testing-phase
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.logs: cf logs btp-admin | grep --line-buffered -v -E '\[RTR|\[API|\[CELL|\[PROXY|\[STG' | node scripts/format-logs.mjs
scripts.logs-idle: cf logs btp-admin-idle | grep --line-buffered -v -E '\[RTR|\[API|\[CELL|\[PROXY|\[STG' | node scripts/format-logs.mjs
scripts.logs-recent: cf logs btp-admin --recent | grep --line-buffered -v -E '\[RTR|\[API|\[CELL|\[PROXY|\[STG' | node scripts/format-logs.mjs
